title: Chapter 457 Killing The Ghost
content:
Chapter 457 Killing The Ghost

Wang Shuo cautiously approached. The ground was full of gravel and rotten wood chips.

Coming closer, Wang Shuo saw clearly the words on the tombstone.

"Liu Han's Tomb."

At this moment, the tombstone shook and a puff of black smoke poured out.

Wang Shuo was shocked, it was death energy.

A humanoid ghost appeared in front of Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo was startled. This ghost was different from the skeletons Wang Shuo had seen. The body was not dilapidated, but almost like a normal person.

The only difference was probably the deathly aura permeating his body.

"Jiejie..."

This monster, who should be named Liu Han, let out a strange laugh.

Wang Shuo was not absolutely afraid of the scene that was supposed to be eerie.

Because he was used to it, he had killed countless undead creatures.

However, Liu Han's exposed aura surprised Wang Shuo.

It should have the peak strength of a senior warrior.

Wang Shuo didn't dare to be careless and immediately took out the Shura Demon-Breaking Spear and pointed it at Liu Han.

Liu Han seemed to ignore Wang Shuo, minding his own business, and had no intention of attacking Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo was on alert, and for a moment, he was a little confused about the situation.

In this King's Tomb, how can we break through to the King?

Liu Han looked at the surroundings blankly, seeming to be recalling something.

"Who am I and where am I?"

He kept mumbling to himself, sometimes baring his teeth and claws, and the expression on his face also changed.

"ah!"

With a scream, he seemed to remember something, causing a splitting headache.

He kept slapping his head with his hands.

"I am the king of the Tuxie Empire..."

With a roar, all the energy in his body exploded, causing ripples in the surrounding air.

Wang Shuo's eyes widened and he took a step back.

A lunatic, Wang Shuo didn't intend to pay attention to him anymore, turned around and left.

"Don't you want the keys on me?"

Wang Shuo stopped when he heard this.

"What key?"

Wang Shuo said doubtfully.

"It turns out you don't know anything! Hahaha, beat me. If you win, I will tell you."

Wang Shuo noticed at this time that Liu Han seemed reluctant to leave the tombstone.

However, Wang Shuo felt that he should be able to defeat Liu Han, so he stopped cowering and took the initiative to attack.

After a few rounds of fighting, Wang Shuo had already figured out the opponent's strength. He used the move "Dragon Leaping to the Sea" and then added the move "Go Directly to the Yellow Dragon", which directly penetrated the opponent's body.

[Kill ghosts 1/100. 】

A system prompt sounded in Wang Shuo's mind.

He hadn't heard this voice for a long time, and Wang Shuo still missed it a little.

Wang Shuo remembered that the last system prompt said that only in some special places, some system functions were still retained.

It seems that this place should be a special place.

After killing Liu Han, he directly turned into death energy and got into the tomb again.

"Damn it, how dare you lie to me."

Wang Shuo didn't know why the other party forced him to fight with him, but it was obviously something that was good for him.

Wang Shuo was a little unwilling and began to search carefully around the cemetery.

What if the key the other party mentioned exists?

After searching for a long time, I found nothing.

Wang Shuo was a little angry and threw it directly at the tombstone.

"Liu Han, come out, if you don't give me an explanation."

"I just smashed your tombstone and made you a lonely ghost without even a name."

According to Wang Shuo's observation just now, if it weren't for the tombstone to remind him, he might have forgotten who he was.
